added_lines: sr. eileen - cúinne domhnach na misean inniu domhnach domhanda na misean. ón bhliain 1926 ar aghaidh tá an eaglais ag comóradh agus ag cuimhneamh ar a misean uilíoch. is lá ar leith é atá eagraithe ag craobhscaoileadh an chreidimh chun deis a thabhairt do chaitlicigh ar fud an domhain iad féin a ath-thiomnúd’obair mhisinéireachta na h eaglaise trí ghuí agus trí ghníomh. déantar an ceiliúradh seo ar an lá céanna i ngach paróiste ar fud an domhain. nuair a baisteadh sinn tugadh misean dúinn maireachtáil mar dhaoine de chlann an tsolais agus mar thoradh ar sintá dualgas orainn solas chríost a chraobhscaoileadh go himill chríocha na cruinne. ar an lá speisialta seo tugtar deis dúinn athnuachan a dhéanamh ar an misean a thug dia dúinn agus cabhrú le misean na h eaglaise lenár n-urnaithe agus ár n-íobairtí chomh maith le hairgead a chur ar fáil dár misinéirí. mission sunday today is world mission sunday. since 1926, the church has remembered its universal mission. it is a special day set aside by propagation of the faith so that catholics worldwide can rededicate themselves to the missionary work of the church by prayer and action. every parish in the world celebrates this day on the same date. when we were baptised we were given the mission to live as members of the family of light and as a result we have an obligation to spread the light of christ to the whole world. on this special day we get the opportunity to renew our commitment to the mission given to us by god and to assist the mission of the church by our prayers and sacrifices as well as providing financial help for missionaries. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ preparing for sacraments 2027 we welcome the children from mercy who will be participating in 7.30pm mass, carrig . who will be
